EVERY DANCER STARTS SOMEWHERE

Come For The Music. Stay For The Dancing.

There’s more than one way to find your feet in Kobe’s swing community. Join us to learn, share a few steps and enjoy the music together.

♫

Special Workshops

We don’t currently offer regular lessons in Kobe, but we host occasional workshops when visiting teachers are in town. It’s a lovely chance to discover something new and grow your dancing.

✦

Fridays In The Park

We usually meet in the park on Friday evenings to learn from one another and dance together. Come along, meet the community and share a little swing under the stars.

Let’s Get You Dancing

Check Facebook and Instagram for upcoming events and the latest Friday gathering details, or email us to ask about the next workshop or lesson.
